heading_en: Net JTD Risk Positions of Securitization Products (Non-CTP)
summary_ja: 証券化商品(非CTP)のグロスJTDリスク・ポジションの相殺できない範囲とできる範囲を定め、前三条の規定を準用して、ネットJTDリスク・ポジションを算出する。
summary_en: Specifies which gross JTD risk positions of securitization products (non-CTP) may not and may be offset, and applies the preceding provisions mutatis mutandis to calculate net JTD risk positions.
paragraphs: Gross JTD risk positions of securitization products (non-CTP) shall not be offset between the following exposures: (i) Between securitization exposures, etc. (meaning transactions that transfer the credit risk of the underlying assets to a third party; the same applies hereinafter) referencing different underlying assets (including between securitization exposures having the same attachment point (meaning the point at which a securitization exposure first incurs losses; the same applies in paragraph (3) of Article 269) and the same detachment point (meaning the point at which credit losses allocated to a securitization exposure extend to the entire principal; the same applies in that paragraph)); (ii) Between securitization exposures, etc. arising from different tranches of securitization products referencing the same underlying assets.

With respect to the default risk of securitization products (non-CTP), offsetting may be made between the following exposures: (i) Between securitization exposures, etc. whose terms are identical other than maturity; (ii) Between the same individual reference assets obtained by decomposing the long positions and short positions of securitization exposures, etc. into the individual assets referencing their underlying assets.

The provisions of Article 267 through the preceding Article shall apply mutatis mutandis to the calculation of JTD risk positions of securitization products (non-CTP). In this case, the term "non-securitization products" in those provisions shall be deemed to be replaced with "securitization products (non-CTP)." (Calculation of the Market Risk Equivalent Amount for Default Risk of Securitization Products (Non-CTP))
